source.title: Source collection and path
source.description: Where the data currently lives. For a single file, give the file path. Keep this outside the folder the Compute endpoint can see.

destination.title: Destination collection and path
destination.description: Full destination path of the file (for example /Users/me/globus-destination/data.json). The folder must be the one the Compute endpoint mounts. On failure this path is deleted recursively, so never use the source path or a folder with existing data.

search_index.title: Search index
search_index.description: UUID of the Globus Search index to ingest into.

subject.title: Search subject
subject.description: Unique Search subject, for example powerball-2026-11.

visible_to.title: Visible to
visible_to.description: Principal URNs allowed to see the entry, or 'public'.

notify.title: Email settings
notify.description: Sender and SMTP server for the completion email, which is sent to the person running the flow.

compute.title: Metadata extraction (Globus Compute)
compute.description: Endpoint and function that build the Search metadata from the transferred file.

file_path.title: File path on the endpoint
file_path.description: Filesystem path, as the Compute endpoint sees it, of the transferred file. It must match the destination path.
